label: Gentle Muse · Fall
source: Source: Oxford English Dictionary; Encyclopaedia Britannica · HAL-017
contract: Every holiday carries a fact somebody softened. I post the real one before the day arrives.

beats.html:
A mare was a spirit
believed to sit
on a sleeper's chest.

The weight. The paralysis.
The certainty something
is in the room.

People had a word for it
centuries before
they had an explanation.

Somebody you know has
woken up unable to move.
It has always had a name.
